summary: Sustained elevated 5xx after regional failover; retry amplification and serving-runtime crashloops
description: Issue summary: After an automated regional failover on 2026-03-10 at ~03:14 UTC, NoteBase began observing sustained 5xx responses for their production traffic. Impact: customer reports 30-40% of requests returning 5xx (502/503/504) for ~90 minutes and higher latency for the remainder. Environment: NoteBase dedicated tenancy; traffic routed from us-west-2 to eu-west-1 as part of failover policy. Immediate business impact: degraded UX for end users, automated client retries increased request volume.
impact: Customer-facing production errors; estimated 35% elevated 5xx rate for the customer’s routes; increased cost due to retries and partial throttling by gateway.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Trigger a regional failover by simulating control-plane evicted nodes scenario in us-west-2 (internal test). 2) Observe routing shift to eu-west-1. 3) Under steady client QPS with exponential backoff disabled, observe a ramp of 5xxs within 5-10 minutes as KV cache warms and runtimes restart. 4) Verify serving-runtime logs showing OOM-ish restarts and high GC/CPU prior to 5xx wave.
logs_and_metrics: Summarized metrics: gateway 5xx rate jump at 03:14 UTC; serving-runtime process restarts increased 6x; average p95 latency rose from 180ms to 900ms; worker OOM and eviction logs in runtime. Dashboard links: https://metrics.redwood.ai/d/ingress/route-NoteBase?from=164&to=204, runtime crash heatmap: https://dash.redwood.ai/runtime/crashmap?range=2h.
investigation_notes: 03:20 UTC - Initial triage: observed routing diverted to eu-west-1; autoscaler initiated scale-up but aggressive scale-down cooldown was still in place causing unstable pool size.
03:35 UTC - Hypothesis: client retries (no jitter) created retry amplification hitting runtimes before KV cache/memory warmed, causing thrash and restarts leading to 5xxs.
03:50 UTC - Evidence: runtime logs show frequent cache misses and high alloc rates; OOM-like terminations preceded many 5xx events. Stack traces attached in linked PR notes.

04:10 UTC - Correlation: customer client library was configured with immediate retries (3 attempts, no backoff). We reproduced locally by issuing concurrent requests with retries and observed similar crash pattern.
04:45 UTC - Temporary mitigation applied: added per-tenant gateway rate-limit and low-priority queuing for NoteBase routes; observed reduction in restart frequency.

05:30 UTC - Follow-ups identified: autoscaler cooldown tweak, gateway retry budget enforcement, and an autoserver-side prewarm path for KV cache on failover events. See PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-runtime/pull/3482 for prewarm prototype.
comments: Aisha Patel (Support) 2026-03-10 03:25 UTC: Customer reported large fraction of 5xxs after failover. Escalating to SRE — tagging @sre-oncall.

Lina Cho (SRE) 2026-03-10 03:33 UTC: Observed high restart rate of serving-runtime in eu-west-1; suspect retry amplification. Temporarily applied per-tenant throttling to NoteBase routes; monitoring impact.

Marco Bell (Runtime Eng) 2026-03-10 04:05 UTC: We can reproduce with a local harness using immediate retries. Opening PR for a conservative prewarm + longer autoscaler warmup: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-runtime/pull/3482
Customer (NoteBase SRE) 2026-03-10 04:22 UTC: Thanks — we will update our client SDK to add jittered backoff, but we need platform-side mitigations in case of future failovers.

Lina Cho (SRE) 2026-03-10 05:00 UTC: Applied mitigation looks effective — 5xx rate dropped to baseline after throttling and temporary route fallback to older model variant. Continuing to monitor; will roll platform fixes in next patch window.

Marco Bell (Runtime Eng) 2026-03-12 09:12 UTC: Patch landed to the autoscaler (increase min cooldown to 5m on failover) and gateway now enforces retry budgets per-tenant. Tracking: INT-4130 for staging rollout.
Aisha Patel (Support) 2026-03-12 11:00 UTC: Customer confirmed improved behavior and reduced errors post-fixes. Preparing summary for post-incident review and follow-up action items.
resolution: Workaround: applied per-tenant gateway throttling and routed a subset of traffic to an older model variant to reduce memory pressure. Permanent fixes: (1) autoscaler cooldown increase on failover, (2) gateway-level retry budget enforcement, (3) build KV prewarm path triggered on routing shifts. PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-runtime/pull/3482 contains prewarm prototype; autoscaler change tracked under INT-4130. Customer confirmed resolution on 2026-03-12; ticket will remain open until postmortem published.
